title: Hypervisor detection in 2020: separate possibilities from observations
summary: A secret.club multi-author investigation compares possible system-emulation signals with checks its authors reported observing in BattlEye and Easy Anti-Cheat. It is useful precisely because theoretical detection ideas and product-specific evidence are not the same thing.
author: Observatory editorial
takeaways: An architecture-based detection idea is not evidence that a named vendor deployed it.
The authors reported 2020 timing checks in both products and additional EAC-specific observations, with no general present-day coverage claim.
Timing and processor-state anomalies need benign-baseline testing before they are treated as actionable risk signals.

sections.title: Two layers of evidence in one article
